description: Post Tropical Storm Chalane (5 event data sets, Globhe Drones, on HDX) is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Globhe Drones. Drone orthomosaic. Post Tropical Storm Chalane Mapping, Malawi conducted with Crowddroning by GLOBHE. More maps and data available on demand upon request from locations globally at MORE CROWDDRONING BY GLOBHE Web: Facebook: Twitter: Instagram: LinkedIn:. Coverage: Malawi. The portal lists 5 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Globhe Drones. Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons. It offers 1 resource(s) in GEOTIFF. The portal shows 2026-07-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
